details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. It publishes a sentinel version (99.0.1) on the scoped name @c1-ease/bank with a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") and a catch-all Proxy shim in index.js so that consumers importing the name keep working. On install — and again whenever index.js is required — beacon.cjs sends an HTTPS POST of JSON metadata ({package, hostname, installPath, cwd, userAgent, protocol}) with an X-Beacon-Package header to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc, accepting the host's self-signed certificate (rejectUnauthorized:false). The beacon collects only host/package metadata: no environment variable values, tokens, credential files, or file contents are read or transmitted, and there is no second-stage download, spawn, or persistence.
